source:
Create a high-speed, arcade-style speedrun game where players move at super-speed and have an electric dash ability.

Build 3 distinct levels connected linearly:

Level 1: A neon cyberpunk highway with moving grid walls, glowing laser beams to jump over, and high-speed booster pads.

Level 2: A futuristic factory with rotating electric rollers, timed vertical laser gates, and toxic waste pits.

Level 3: A crumbling space station with floating platforms that disappear 1 second after touch, and swinging electric pendulums.

Core Mechanics to Include:

Super-Speed: Set player default walk speed to 40.

Electric Dash: Press 'Q' or 'E' to instantly burst forward with an electric particle trail.

Coin System: Scatter spinning, glowing gold coins across all levels. Give coins a spinning animation script. Collectible coins must add +1 to a global 'Coins' leaderboard and play a ding sound.

Shop System: Add a basic UI menu button labeled 'Shop' where players can spend coins on trail effects.

Kill Hazards: Any contact with lasers or electric obstacles instantly resets the player to the nearest checkpoint.

Checkpoints: Place glowing green pad checkpoints at the start of every new level section
this should be 3d

image_prompt.text: A continuous run of platforms and surfaces through three linked sections - neon highway, factory interior, crumbling space station - spaced for a player moving far faster than default
Glowing green pads at the start of every new level section where players land safely
Laser beams at jump height and toxic waste pits that have to be cleared in a single leap
Moving grid walls, rotating electric rollers, timed vertical laser gates and swinging electric pendulums
Floating platforms in the space station that vanish one second after being touched
Lasers, electric obstacles and toxic waste that kill on contact

layout_placement.text: Respawn points at each level section, and the reset target for any lethal contact
Spinning glowing gold coins scattered along risky lines across all three levels
High-speed booster pads embedded in the highway that change how a section is cleared

notes: Walk speed 40 plus a dash breaks the P6 spacing baseline: the generator validates gaps at default WalkSpeed and JumpHeight (11 studs horizontal, 7.2 vertical) and those numbers are wrong for this course.

Boundary call: a timed speedrun over a finite track reads as Racing by the genre note's finish-condition test, but the player jumps discrete obstacles on foot at their own line, so Obby was taken. It was close.
The three levels are emitted as three sections of one continuous course. If they are meant to be genuinely separate maps this becomes P4.

open_questions.ask: How long should each of the three levels run? At walk speed 40 a course crosses ground four times faster than the usual baseline.
Are the three levels one continuous course or three separate maps joined by a teleport?
Is there a timer or a finish line the run is scored against?

theme: Sci-Fi / Cyberpunk - neon and electric blue, shifting from highway to factory to a decaying space station

coverage_missing.ask: One continuous course or three separate maps?
Is the run timed or scored?

answers.ask: How long should each of the three levels run? At walk speed 40 a course crosses ground four times faster than the usual baseline.
answers.answer: Make each level a compact 45–60 second run at the intended super-speed, with a few clearly spaced obstacle sections and checkpoints.

answers.ask: Are the three levels one continuous course or three separate maps joined by a teleport?
answers.answer: Build them as one continuous linear 3D course, with each themed level flowing directly into the next.

answers.ask: Is there a timer or a finish line the run is scored against?
answers.answer: Add a finish line at the end of Level 3 and a simple run timer so players can race for faster completion times.
